output.question: What is Samsung's annual revenue?
output.answer: Samsung Electronics' latest completed fiscal-year annual revenue was KRW 333.6 trillion for FY2025, reported on January 29, 2026. The audited consolidated statement gives the exact figure as KRW 333,605,938 million (approximately USD 234,622,273 thousand); FY2026 was not yet a completed fiscal year as of November 11, 2026.

key_facts.fact: Samsung Electronics reported KRW 333.6 trillion in annual revenue for the full year 2025.
Samsung Electronics' consolidated statement reports 2025 revenue of KRW 333,605,938 million and USD 234,622,273 thousand.

passages.quote: For the full year, the Company reported KRW 333.6 trillion in annual revenue and KRW 43.6 trillion in operating profit.

caveats: This answer interprets 'Samsung' as Samsung Electronics Co., Ltd., not Samsung Group as a whole.
The latest completed annual figure is FY2025; FY2026 annual revenue was not yet available as of 2026-11-11.
